aspect_ratio.description: Output size, default `1:1`. Use a ratio (`1:1` `3:2` `2:3` `4:3` `3:4` `5:4` `4:5` `16:9` `9:16` `2:1` `1:2` `21:9` `9:21` `3:1` `1:3`) together with `resolution` (1K / 2K / 4K), or give exact pixels as `WxH`, e.g. `1152x1536` (both sides multiples of 16, each side 16–3840, total pixels 655,360–8,294,400, long side at most 3× the short side). Price depends on framing × resolution tier × quality. Framing comes from long side ÷ short side: Square < 1.3 (1:1, 5:4, 4:5), Standard 1.3–2 (4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 2:1 and their portrait versions), Panorama > 2 (21:9, 3:1 and their portrait versions). With a ratio, the tier follows the actual output pixels of the chosen `resolution` (long side capped at 3840, so 3:1 / 1:3 at 4K outputs 3840×1280 and is billed as 2K); with `WxH`, the tier follows total pixels (up to 2,097,152 is 1K, up to 5,242,880 is 2K, above that is 4K). If omitted, billed as `1:1` (Square).
aspect_ratio.title: Image size

framing.description: Billing tier computed by the server from `aspect_ratio`. Do not send it (requests that include it return 400). Square: long side ÷ short side < 1.3; Standard: 1.3–2; Panorama: > 2.
framing.title: Framing

x-hiapi-pricing-note.de: 1K / 2K / 4K richten sich nach der Gesamtpixelzahl der tatsächlichen Ausgabe: 1K etwa 1 MP (z. B. 1024×1024, bis 2.097.152), 2K etwa 4 MP (z. B. 2048×2048, bis 5.242.880), 4K alles darüber (max. 3840×2160 = 8.294.400).
x-hiapi-pricing-note.en: 1K / 2K / 4K are tiered by the actual output's total pixels: 1K is about 1 MP (e.g. 1024×1024, up to 2,097,152), 2K about 4 MP (e.g. 2048×2048, up to 5,242,880), 4K anything above (max 3840×2160 = 8,294,400).
x-hiapi-pricing-note.es: 1K / 2K / 4K se determinan por los píxeles totales de la imagen generada: 1K ≈ 1 MP (p. ej. 1024×1024, hasta 2.097.152), 2K ≈ 4 MP (p. ej. 2048×2048, hasta 5.242.880), 4K por encima (máx. 3840×2160 = 8.294.400).
x-hiapi-pricing-note.fr: 1K / 2K / 4K sont déterminés par le nombre total de pixels de l'image produite : 1K ≈ 1 MP (ex. 1024×1024, jusqu'à 2 097 152), 2K ≈ 4 MP (ex. 2048×2048, jusqu'à 5 242 880), 4K au-delà (max 3840×2160 = 8 294 400).
x-hiapi-pricing-note.it: 1K / 2K / 4K dipendono dai pixel totali dell'immagine generata: 1K ≈ 1 MP (es. 1024×1024, fino a 2.097.152), 2K ≈ 4 MP (es. 2048×2048, fino a 5.242.880), 4K oltre (max 3840×2160 = 8.294.400).
x-hiapi-pricing-note.pt: 1K / 2K / 4K são definidos pelo total de pixels da imagem gerada: 1K ≈ 1 MP (ex.: 1024×1024, até 2.097.152), 2K ≈ 4 MP (ex.: 2048×2048, até 5.242.880), 4K acima disso (máx. 3840×2160 = 8.294.400).
x-hiapi-pricing-note.ru: 1K / 2K / 4K определяются общим числом пикселей готового изображения: 1K — около 1 МП (напр. 1024×1024, до 2 097 152), 2K — около 4 МП (напр. 2048×2048, до 5 242 880), 4K — больше (макс. 3840×2160 = 8 294 400).
